name: חֵלֶק
summary: A son of Gilead of the tribe of Manasseh, head of the clan of the Helekites (הַחֶלְקִי), one of the six families of Manasseh west of the Jordan that received their portion of the land by lot. The name is the noun חֵלֶק “portion”, and his sons are named in the very chapter where Manasseh's portion is given (Jos 17:2, 5).

evidence.note: “The sons of Gilead: … of Helek, the clan of the Helekite.”
The lot fell “for the sons of Helek” among the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

note: Takes h.da.ac (the name, but BDB's 30 tokens are every חֵלֶק by spelling; only Num 26:30 and Jos 17:2 are the man) and h.da.ad, the gentilic חֶלְקִי (Num 26:30, 1 token), which TIPNR records as a group form of the same person. The name is read simply as the noun; no verse explains it.
